a64-function.body:
.global example
.type example, %function
example:
    stp x29, x30, [sp, #-16]!
    mov x29, sp
    // body: preserve any other callee-saved registers used
    ldp x29, x30, [sp], #16
    ret
.size example, .-example

a64-currentel.body:
mrs x0, CurrentEL
lsr x0, x0, #2

a64-vbar.description: Set EL1 vector base (requires EL1+, aligned table)
a64-vbar.body:
adrp x0, vector_table
add x0, x0, :lo12:vector_table
msr VBAR_EL1, x0
isb

a64-mmio.body:
ldr x0, =0x09000000 // replace with device register address
ldr w1, [x0]
// update w1 according to the register specification
str w1, [x0]
